evidence: Matches the P2P label and changes outbound message queuing in src/net.cpp and src/net.h
rationale: Prevents memory corruption and process termination in P2P transport encoding by validating outbound message limits before queuing. As noted in the description, an oversized message type causes 'V1 transport encoding to abort and V2 transport to either truncate the type or write past its encoding buffer', making defensive enforcement in CConnman::PushMessage() an important reliability and safety improvement.
